units.source_text: “所谓人造人，是不是前阵子你在百货商店里看见的，怪里怪气的活像印度女佛般的广告偶人呢？

en.t: By an artificial human, do you mean that strange advertising mannequin you saw at the department store the other day, looking just like some Indian female Buddha?

units.source_text: 不错，那是哀伤的象征啊！

en.t: Yes, that is a symbol of sorrow!

units.source_text: 据说制造‘人造人’的美国电器公司的工程师，把这种机器人称为‘声控机器人’。

en.t: They say the engineer at the American electrical company that made the artificial human called this kind of robot a voice-controlled robot.

units.source_text: 其实就是个小箱子，毕竟是个工程师啊！

en.t: In reality it is just a little box, after all he is an engineer!

units.source_text: 从机器人方面来看，它戴着人的假面具，必须一个劲地讨得顾客的欢心，这简直就是笨蛋嘛。

en.t: From the robot's point of view, having to wear a human mask and endlessly curry favor with customers is simply foolish.

units.source_text: 若论发出声音，那留声机、收音机远比它进步。”

en.t: If it is only a matter of making sounds, then gramophones and radios are far more advanced than it is.”
